summary: LPA, a NYSE American-listed Latin American logistics REIT, filed a 6-K disclosing an agreement to sell stabilized income-producing facilities at Parque Logístico Calle 80 in Bogotá, Colombia, to Bancolombia S.A., a Grupo Cibest subsidiary, for COP 500 billion (about US$152 million) in cash. The five fully leased buildings total roughly 1.26 million sq ft; pricing implies an 8.2% in-place cap rate and sits within about 5% of latest appraisal. Closing is expected early Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions; no board recommendation or advisor named. Proceeds are for capital reallocation.
